definitions.explanation: The body's ability to resist infection and disease through biological processes.

⟦ワクチン→ワクチン：05074_wakuchin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{免疫|めんえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Vaccines provide immunity against specific diseases.

notes:
{免疫|めんえき} refers to immunity or the immune system. {免|めん} means 'exemption' and {疫|えき} means 'epidemic/disease.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {免疫|めんえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have immunity
- {免疫|めんえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to develop immunity
- {免疫|めんえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to boost immunity
- {免疫|めんえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}する→低下：04065_teika⟧: immunity decreases
- {免疫|めんえき}⟦{力|りょく}→力：01661_chikara⟧: immune strength
